Benchtop spectrofluorometer by Horiba Scientific
The FluoroMax Plus benchtop spectrofluorometer from Horiba Scientific offers the option of a second detector and two-position grating turret to allow wavelengths out to 1650 nm and time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC) performance down to 25 ps, enabling faster measurement of weaker and smaller samples.
Sept. 22, 2014
 Add Us On Google
Content Dam Bow En Articles 2014 09 Benchtop Spectrofluorometer By Horiba Scientific Leftcolumn Article Thumbnailimage File
The FluoroMax Plus benchtop spectrofluorometer from Horiba Scientific (Edison, NJ) offers the option of a second detector and two-position grating turret to allow wavelengths out to 1650 nm and time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC) performance down to 25 ps, enabling faster measurement of weaker and smaller samples. The company offers a range of gratings, detectors, and accessories for the spectrofluorometer to fit research application needs such as measurement of solid and liquid samples, high-throughput screening, cryogenic or elevated temperatures, absolute quantum yields, microliter volumes, and micron-scale measurements with a fiber-optic coupling to a microscope.
